guide.title: Field guide
guide.floor: Label only; does not affect calculation.
guide.volume: Element volume (m³). Total mass = volume × (2400 + rebar) kg/m³. EC scales linearly with volume.
guide.concreteStrength: 140–420 kgf/cm². Higher strength → more cement → higher EC.
guide.admixturePct: 0–50%. Portion of cement replaced by fly ash / slag. Higher % → lower EC, higher FR → higher MCIp.
guide.massMineral: Concrete mass = volume × concrete density (default 2400 kg/m³). Classified as mineral.
guide.massMetal: Rebar mass = volume × rebar mass per m³ (default 314 kg/m³ ≈ 4% cross-section). Classified as metal.
guide.materialBreakdown: RC categories only split into mineral (concrete) + metal (rebar); other categories classify by construction name keywords (aluminum/steel/glass/wood/plastic/paint) for now, template-level per-layer breakdown can be added later.
guide.reused: If checked, FU = 100% → MCIp improves substantially.
